_comment: Published-datasource LUID map for the Public-Sector SCRM demo (Tableau Cloud site 'usfederaldemos', pod prod-useast-a, project '60 - Public Sector SCRM Demo', project LUID 9866ccdd-5a7b-45e9-a3d5-bd9ac2abba2c). Set SCRM_MCP_DATASOURCES on pathfinder-mcp to the `env_value` object below (keys are the logical table names the SCRM tools reference). The Suppliers source is the FILTERED datasource — composite_risk_pct is intentionally absent.

datasources.note: Pulse/alert source. risk_score 0-100 (higher=worse), RAG, alert_flag/alert_reason. foci_flag & alert_flag are REAL booleans — VDS SET filters need JSON true, not "true".
FILTERED — composite_risk_pct excluded (verified absent from published fields).
7 KRI defs: threshold, direction, owning_channel, owning_function.
single_source_flag is a REAL boolean. ss-concentration = >=2 single-source parts from China/Taiwan.
